name: smart-clinic
description: Smart Clinic monorepo root (T-001 foundation skeleton).

scripts.check: npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:rtl-ltr && npm run check:sql-structure && npm run check:migrations && npm run check:client-usage && npm run check:openapi-tooling
scripts.verify:backend: dotnet build backend/SmartClinic.sln -c Release && dotnet test backend/SmartClinic.sln -c Release --no-build
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run verify:backend
scripts.migrations:add: dotnet ef migrations add --project backend/src/SmartClinic.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/src/SmartClinic.Migrator --output-dir Persistence/Migrations
scripts.migrations:script: dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent --project backend/src/SmartClinic.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/src/SmartClinic.Migrator
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run openapi:generate:staff && npm run openapi:generate:portal
scripts.generate:clients: npm run generate:clients:staff && npm run generate:clients:portal
